results.note: As of 2026-11-19, web searches found no approval and no new CRL for deramiocel. The 2026-11-22 PDUFA date still stands (the major-amendment extension moved it from 08-22). Roth Capital puts the odds at 25% approval and 75% delay or CRL (lifesciencedaily.news / capricor.com IR). Re-check after 11-22.

Interim milestone went favorably: Compass said on 2026-11-09 that the rolling COMP360 NDA for TRD is complete (Psychiatric Times / HCPLive, 2026-11-09), backed by COMP005, COMP006 and the Ph2b. The terminal FDA action is still ahead and now has a firm clock: under the CNPV's targeted 1-2 month review that points to about Jan 2027 (new_date is my estimate), with launch guided for H1-27 after DEA rescheduling.

CTOS updated PFS/subgroup oral presentation is still scheduled for 2026-11-20 in Seoul (preview coverage), and the terminal PDUFA date of 2027-04-14 is unchanged (Inhibrx PR 2026-06-15). The Q3 results (2026-11-13, BioSpace) show $199.5M cash against a $275M loan; one secondary source (panabee) mentions FDA Form 483 observations at both CMOs, which I could not confirm and which should be checked.

As of 2026-11-19, two web searches turned up no FDA approval and no complete response letter for the MOLBREEVI BLA. The PDUFA goal date is still 2026-11-22, set by the April 2026 three-month extension (oindpnews 2026-04; mychesco/panabee pre-PDUFA coverage). Check again on 11-20 to 11-23, because the goal date is a Sunday and the action could come early.

Fired favorably. On 2026-11-05 Brookfield said in a GlobeNewswire release that it had all required approvals (BIPC vote and BC final order), and on 2026-11-19 a second release announced the simplification complete, with BIP and BIPC now combined as Brookfield Infrastructure Partners Inc. Any index-inclusion demand comes after the close and was not checked here.

The ARCC-MFIC merger signed on 2026-10-27 (about $10.88/sh) is still pending. Searches on 2026-11-19 found no S-4 or vote date and no break, and the 2026-11-05 date was only the cancelled Q3 call, not a deal step. Inside Arbitrage still expects a 1H-2027 close (SEC Form 425, MFIC; insidearbitrage.com).
